<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex28022024-09-2015-39-31" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
      <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon"/><note type="editorial">(ID:6858) does not consider the double shad-s up to "lags". The first two lines are metrical (6 syllables), but not the last portion.</note>
         <l><choice><reg>dpe'</reg><orig>dpe‹'›</orig></choice> legs la dag pa 'di ||</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6857">dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa</rs>||</l>
        <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6857"><abbr>yon tan</abbr> dbang phyug</rs> gis <lb edRef="inst:4664" n="39b7"/> bsam pa bzang ba'i <choice><corr>bsgo</corr><orig>dgo bsgo</orig></choice><note type="editorial">We follow (ID:6858) - which reads "sgo" - in considering "dgo" to be a scribal mistake that was not deleted.</note> nas × bzhengs pa lags || </l> 
      maMgalaMb+hazhwatu: shub+haM: zhus dag | dge |<note type="editorial">(ID:6858) only reads "man+ga laM | shu b+haM".</note>
      </seg></TEI>
